The NYPD is searching for at least four suspects behind what is clearly a coordinated act of Jew hatred. But this does not happen in a vacuum. Zohran Mamdani and others like him have spent years elevating rhetoric that isolates, vilifies, and dehumanizes Jews under the guise of politics.
